question: What ritual repetition is prescribed to the god-worshipped deity using the syllable-mass situated on the forehead?
premises: The practice involves what is situated in the syllable-mass on the forehead.
The prescribed act is to be performed one hundred thousand times.
The instruction is addressed to a deity worshipped by the gods.
inference: A hundred-thousandfold repetition focused on the forehead's syllable-mass is enjoined in address to the god-worshipped deity.
uncertainties: The exact nature of the syllable-mass on the forehead is not specified in this verse alone.
plain_english: O god worshipped by the gods, having performed one hundred thousand repetitions of that which is situated in the mass of syllables on the forehead.
